ValidationRule.description: The Opp owner and the BDR Owner can't be the same.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", Probability >0.95, BDR_Owner__r.Id = OwnerId, Opp_Val_Bypass__c = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The BDR and the Opportunity Owner can not be the same person. If you are a Sales rep and you did not get this Opportunity from a BDR, leave this blank. Otherwise, enter the name of the BDR who prospected this lead for you.
